# Contributing

The contributing guide lives at **[documents/CONTRIBUTING.md](../documents/CONTRIBUTING.md)** —
clone to a committed change, in the order the work happens.

This file exists only so GitHub finds it. GitHub looks for `CONTRIBUTING.md` in the
repository root, in `.github/`, or in `docs/`, and the canon lives in `documents/`
(see [README.md](../README.md) § *The documents* for why), which is none of those
three. One sentence here buys back the "Contributing guidelines" link on every new
issue and pull request. Do not put guidance in this file: two copies drift, and the
one nobody edits is the one people read.
